{{video id="BTf3XX68-5I" title="Video Modal" desc="Turn covers and buttons into click-to-play videos."}}

Video Modal turns a Cover or Button block into a click-to-play video launcher. Visitors click your beautifully designed cover image or button, and the video opens in a clean, accessible lightbox — no cluttered inline embeds, no leaving the page.

## Setting It Up

Select a **Cover** or **Button** block and open the **Video Modal** panel in the sidebar. Choose your **Video Source**:

- **YouTube** — paste any YouTube URL into the **YouTube URL** field: regular watch links, short youtu.be links, Shorts, and embed URLs all work. You'll see a thumbnail preview to confirm the right video, and a **Start Time** field (like `1:30`, or plain seconds) if you want to skip an intro. If your URL already carries a timestamp, it's picked up automatically.
- **Media Library** — click **Select Video** to use any video file from your WordPress media library instead.

That's it — as soon as a valid video is set, the block becomes clickable. There's no separate enable switch; remove the video and the block goes back to normal.

## Options

- **Autoplay video** — on by default, so the video starts the moment the modal opens.
- **Play Icon** (Cover blocks) — control the play button overlay: **Show** it always, reveal it on **Hover**, or **Hide** it entirely if your cover design has its own call to action.

## Good to Know

- The modal is fully accessible: it opens as a proper dialog, traps keyboard focus, closes with Escape or a click outside, and returns focus to where the visitor left off. Cover triggers are keyboard-operable too.
- Links or buttons placed inside a video Cover block still work normally — clicking them won't open the modal.
- The modal's scripts and styles only load on pages that actually use a video modal.
- A great pattern: pair a Cover block video modal with the Motion Gradient or Texture extensions for a designed video section with zero stock imagery.
